sources.locator: Status; tour; installation; kit; planned rail
sources.finding: Mac14+ AppleSilicon desktop2.0.10, free MIT. Real local agent CLIs; roofd persistence; optional Linear; Factory/Agents/Train/Ship marked planned. Current Objective workflow and separate roof swarm kit differ.

sources.title: One Roof app/Package.swift
sources.finding: Native Swift macOS14 AppKit/Metal app with GhosttyKit terminal and Swift/C/Zig roofd; SQLite core. No Electron or webview client.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/Session.swift
sources.finding: AgentKind supports Claude,Codex,Gemini,Antigravity,Kimi,OpenCode,Goose,shell. Session model has stableID, tags, notes, planned/next/running/needs-you/ready/idle/exited and prompt/account/project metadata.

sources.title: One Roof app/roofd/Sources/roofd/Daemon.swift
sources.finding: Native daemon creates per-session holder processes, lists/reuses existing IDs, routes info/read/input/signal/close and scheduler operations. Session runtime lives on local Mac.

sources.title: One Roof app/roofd/Sources/roofd/Wire.swift
sources.finding: Local sockets carry framed terminal input/output/control with1MiB payload limit; no HTTP cloud/team identity transport.

sources.title: One Roof app/roofd/Sources/roofd/main.swift
sources.finding: Product CLI exposes attach/list/info/read/input/create/close/report and scoped issue-state/comment requests with reply waits.

sources.title: One Roof bin/roof
sources.locator: command dispatch; install and guard setup
sources.finding: roof installs workspace guard/wrappers/common instructions, checks/uninstalls, links skills and routes swarm to fanout.py. It is a separate command-line kit usable without app.

sources.title: One Roof tools/fanout.py
sources.finding: Kit runner validates nonoverlapping file claims, parallel cap4/default2, timeout900seconds/retries1 default capped3, disk minimum1GiB; worktrees, post-run claim checking, optional checks, green commits and explicit separate merge stopping on conflict.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/Objectives.swift
sources.finding: Objective has doneWhen, plan steps and dependencies, agent/account/model, result markers and saved state. PlanRunner starts ready dependencies up to3, failure marks objective failed; no arbitrary nested epics.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoof/AppModel+Objectives.swift
sources.finding: Reachable New Objective flow starts visible planner, loads editable Markdown plan, waits for approval then runs dependency-ready steps; pause prevents new launches. Current system is distinct from planned Factory recipes.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoof/UI/ObjectiveView.swift
sources.finding: File New Objective sheet supplies goal/doneWhen/repo/urgency; plan editing and explicit approval are exposed in Objective UI.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/Linear.swift
sources.locator: LinearClient.gql; workstreams; issues; createIssue; setState; comment
sources.finding: Optional user-key Linear API reads teams/projects/issues/milestones and creates projects/issues, updates states, posts comments and uploads files; project/issue IDs are Linear IDs.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/IssueUpdates.swift
sources.finding: Agent may request only linked session issue updates, limited to In Progress/QA and comments; Shipped/Canceled stay human. App applies with owner key, validates before update and answers requester.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/PermissionMode.swift
sources.finding: New profiles default Manual; old profiles preserve Auto or AntigravityFull. Modes map to harness flags and explicit session flags override. CodexFull bypasses sandbox; GeminiAuto already autoapproves; loops/objective steps have separate policy.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/Loops.swift
sources.finding: Loop triggers until-check/nightly/quiet/event; deterministic controller enforces maxRounds8/maxDuration3hours/sameFailure2 defaults and paused/needs-you states. Events require local adapter files.

sources.title: One Roof app/roofd/Sources/roofd/LoopEngine.swift
sources.finding: Daemon serial loop pass creates worktree before check, checks first, launches rounds through runtime, records rounds, stops on unreadable exitcodes and transitions by controller. Always daemon-owned, not duplicated by app.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/LoopLedger.swift
sources.finding: SQLite run/outcome ledger stores report/issue/PR/commit/file/proposal outcomes and staged/approved/rejected/applied/merged/expired status, decider/time and links. No row deletion path in this ledger.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/LoopHarvest.swift
sources.finding: Explicit Approve opens PR only after local loop check and separate agent judge both pass; missing judge/gh refuses. Push current branch with approval outcome ID and gh pr create; failures restage. Uses mutable branch refs, not exact-SHA approval binding.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/SessionArtifacts.swift
sources.finding: Session artifact list retains up to60 written paths, objective plan, recent matching handoffs and opening screenshots; nonexistent files omitted. References are not immutable byte copies.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/History.swift
sources.finding: Read-only human history view of asks, answers, errors, steps and handovers persisted locally for30days; sessions remain named after closure/deletion.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/SessionStoreHistory.swift
sources.finding: SQLite history persists session names, events, decisions and filtered action log; mutable local database, no cryptographic integrity proof.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/ConversationRetention.swift
sources.finding: Settings edits Claude cleanupPeriodDays across account files: default30days,90days,1year or36500days labeled Forever. Does not impose retention on Codex/Kimi histories.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/HostedConnections.swift
sources.finding: Optional OpenCode/Goose guarded hosted-model configuration pins agent versions, provider allowlist Together/Fireworks/OpenRouter, budget/request caps, private0600files, verified guard and price checks. Guarded runtime requires external kit ae/hostedsession.py not included in this repo.

sources.title: One Roof app/Sources/OneRoofCore/MemoryWatchdog.swift
sources.finding: Watchdog measures own daemon/holder footprint: holder warns1024MiB, stops2048MiB, configurable env thresholds. This is not proof of child-agent aggregate RAM containment.

sources.title: One Roof docs/help/00_setup-guide.md
sources.finding: User selects project root and separately authenticates agent accounts; app does not automatically check updates. Check now opens release page.

sources.title: One Roof docs/help/07_seats-router-and-on-device-model.md
sources.finding: Multiple config-folder accounts for Claude/Codex/Gemini/Kimi, not Antigravity/OpenCode/Goose. Claude optional local rate-limit files and Codex logs supply gauges;6hour-old values ignored. Router avoids same vendor family for reviewer.

sources.title: One Roof docs/help/14_loops.md
sources.finding: Public loop workflow stages results for owner approval; native model can run checks and round logic. Current events require ae adapter or another file producer, not a built-in hosted webhook receiver.

sources.title: One Roof LICENSE
sources.finding: MIT license covers OneRoof repository; third-party notices separately cover included components.

sources.title: one-roof app/Sources/OneRoof/SelfTest.swift
sources.finding: ONEROOF_SELFTEST_DEMO seeds six named local sessions and disables a real Linear account. AppModel.poll excludes live sessions in this mode; this is a self-test fixture, not observed concurrency.

sources.title: one-roof app/Sources/OneRoof/UI/EvalsView.swift
sources.finding: Save panel invokes external EvalEngine export with format and output path; implementation is a wrapper, while engine readiness and draft status remain separate.
